signal: Deed was acquired by Bonterra in March 2026 to build an AI-forward CSR platform, uniting Deed's employee engagement with Bonterra's grantmaking

email.body1:
Chad, saw Deed join Bonterra to build an AI-forward CSR platform, pairing your employee-engagement product with their grantmaking.

A combination like that usually opens more enterprise accounts than the team can cover during integration, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Deed off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chad, quick follow-up for Deed.

After joining a larger platform, the cross-sell list grows faster than the sales team does, and most VPs don't know exactly how many meetings it takes to convert it. The gap shows up late and becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Deed needs to cover the combined footprint this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chad, last bit of proof for Deed.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Deed's reply rate likely compares to peer social-impact software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chad, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Folding into a larger platform is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Deed's motion? I'll tailor it to you either way.
